name: Sling Button
description: A button that pulls like a slingshot; releasing flings the pad out of its seat and scatters particles.
interactionNotes: Drag the button; the band stretches and the power arc fills. Once you pass the arming threshold, releasing launches it: the pad leaves its seat, particles spread in a cone, and then it returns. If you release before it arms, it springs back and sends nothing. A simple tap also sends (if `tapSends` is on), and Enter and Space always do.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the pad. Defaults to an up arrow.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when releasing while armed, on a tap (if `tapSends` is on), and on Enter or Space.

props.name: padColor
props.description: The fill of the pad.

props.name: iconColor
props.description: Color of the pad's content.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: The power arc, the arming band and the launch point.

props.name: wellColor
props.description: The seat the pad rests on.

props.name: bandColor
props.description: The band before arming.

props.name: size
props.description: Pad diameter, px. The seat, hit area and launch point scale with it too.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Thickness of the arc and band, px. The band gets thinner as it stretches.

props.name: armAt
props.description: The distance at which the shot arms, px.

props.name: maxPull
props.description: How far the band stretches before it stops giving, px.

props.name: launchSpeed
props.description: The speed the band adds on release, px/s. It determines how far past the seat the pad travels.

props.name: recoil
props.description: Bounce of the return spring; zero means no bounce.

props.name: flight
props.description: How far the leading point travels, px; the rest scatter around it.

props.name: particles
props.description: Number of launch particles. Each gets a random angle, range, size, drift, speed and delay. 1 means a single dot, zero means none.

props.name: spread
props.description: The cone the burst spreads within, in degrees, around the launch direction.

props.name: axis
props.description: Free dragging, or one axis with a little play on the other axis.

props.name: tapSends
props.description: Whether a simple tap also sends; Enter always sends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the pad and ignores input.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Site preview only: it performs the pull, arm and release itself so the flight, the particles and the elastic return can be seen along the real path.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

tips: Dragging without releasing sends nothing — it doesn't arm until you pass `armAt`, and `onSend` isn't called.
`armAt` and `maxPull` work together: the first says where it arms, the second caps the pull. If you bring `armAt` close to `maxPull`, the user has to pull all the way to fire.
For a "send" button, set `armAt` at least larger than `size` so the arming motion extends beyond the pad and stays visible.
Lower `recoil` (e.g. 0.05) for a dry, technical feel; raising it (near 0.3) makes the button more playful.
This component shows no feedback of its own; handle `onSend` and add your own message or state (the site demo does this with a "Sent" label).
Turn on `disabled` while sending so the user doesn't launch again.

Set `particles` to zero if you want the pad to fly out without a burst; `spread` only matters when there are particles. `axis` only constrains the drag axis, not the launch — the launch is always along the drag direction.
